Chrome 商店文案：GEO 场景版

这份文案用于把商店页从“多 AI 对比工具”升级为“GEO 诊断、内容验证、品牌答案监测工具”。

中文标题

AI比一比：多 AI 对比、GEO 诊断与品牌答案监测

英文标题

AI Compare: Multi-AI Compare, GEO Checker & Brand Answer Monitoring

短描述

一次提问，同时对比 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、豆包、Kimi 等 AI 答案，用于 GEO 诊断、内容发布前验证和品牌监测。

Long description

AI Compare helps creators, SEO teams, and brand marketers compare answers from multiple AI platforms in one tab. Use it to: - Run GEO diagnostics and check whether your brand appears in AI answers. - Validate articles before publishing and see whether AI can summarize your core point. - Monitor brand perception across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Doubao, Kimi, and more. - Compare answer differences before deciding which source or model deserves deeper reading. - Export or share readable AI comparison results. It is not only a shortcut for opening AI sites. It is a practical observation tool for understanding how different AI systems interpret the same question.

截图脚本

1. 首图：同一个 GEO 问题在多个 AI 中并排回答 2. 第二张：GEO 诊断报告模板 3. 第三张：内容发布前验证流程 4. 第四张：品牌答案监测问题池 5. 第五张：分享海报或对比结果卡片

multi AI compare, GEO checker, generative engine optimization, brand answer monitoring, content QA, AI search optimization, AI visibility, 多 AI 对比, GEO 优化, 生成式引擎优化, 品牌 AI 搜索监测。
